metric_definitions.line_retention: Per original .js/.cjs/.mjs/.html/.css path: exact nonblank source line multiset intersection divided by original nonblank line count.
metric_definitions.named_functions: Per original source path: distinct names matching function NAME( still matching in that path. Lexical, excludes arrow functions/methods, does not prove execution or body correctness.
metric_definitions.hunks: Proposed counts include repeated proposals in correction/continuation complete blocks; applied counts only committed transactions. Corrected counts committed hunks in the single correction turn. Final runtime separately records unmatched SEARCH and all unapplied transaction hunks.

limitations: One fresh sample per task and flag, with concurrent local runs; no official scoring or finals requirements.
The large starting app received an unchanged practice requirements file from a different domain as a preservation stress test.

The four on runs used a9aa3ac4; post-launch changes concern pending-file continuation instructions, all-rejected delivery recovery and accounting, with no changed normal draft prompt or observed successful application path. The final packaged parser replays all four real replies byte-identically.
Tests are the agent written acceptance suite, not an independent old-behavior or official acceptance suite.
Static line/name retention does not establish behavioral preservation; the ordinary repair loop can still rewrite files.
CNY is calculated from reported gateway usage and the repository price table, not an account balance delta.
